name: Valeren — Advanced — Sword of the Righteous

system.description:
The most talented of Samiel's warriors could call their swords to blaze with cleansing, heavenly fire, a power that helped put the Baali to flight.

System: The Salubri runs a hand along the blade, coating it with his own blood (taking a level of damage in the process), then the player rolls Strength + Occult (difficulty 7). Success sets the sword ablaze with golden flames for the rest of the scene. The flames cannot be smothered by lesser powers of shadow, anyone attacking the wielder is at +1 difficulty due to the brightness, and the weapon deals two additional dice of aggravated damage.
system.source: Clanbook: Salubri (Dark Ages), Chapter Four: The Powers of the Righteous
